title: Output of EORI Number Validator
description: One row per unique EORI in the default dataset (bad formats and outages included as free rows); a run summary in the OUTPUT record.

results.title: EORI checks
results.description: One row per number. Example: {"eori":"GB117223643000","status":"valid","valid":true,"name":"APPLE DISTRIBUTION INTERNATIONAL LIMITED"}. Failed: {"eori":"GB123","status":"invalid_format","error":"..."}.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: JSON: numbersRequested, uniqueChecked, valid, invalid, byStatus, chargeLimitReached, zeroResultsReason, nextSteps.
